# WINCOME Hair Accessories
> Custom Hair Accessories Manufacturer & Supplier — OEM/ODM, Low MOQ, Global Shipping.

## About
WINCOME Hair Accessories is a custom hair accessories manufacturer established in 2010, specializing in hair claws, clips, headbands, scrunchies, hair bows, and decorative accessories for global brands, wholesalers, and retailers. BSCI, ISO 9001, and OEKO-TEX certified. 3,000m² factory with 200+ staff serving 500+ brands across 50 countries.

- Contact: https://wincomehair.com/contact — Multi-step inquiry form with Supabase-backed submission.

## Key Offerings
- OEM & ODM hair accessories manufacturing
- MOQ from 100 pcs per design
- Lead time: 10–18 days after sample approval
- Free design service with 24-hour mockup delivery
- Materials: cellulose acetate, zinc alloy, mulberry silk, premium satin, organic cotton, velvet
- Custom logo: laser engraving, foil stamping, metal plates, woven labels
- Custom packaging: individual cards to luxury gift boxes
- Global shipping: sea freight and air express (DHL/FedEx/UPS)
- Amazon FBA direct shipment supported
- Payment: T/T, PayPal, Trade Assurance via Alibaba
